name: Calligrimm
ability: Liquid Ooze / Sticky Hold / Clear Body (hidden)
look: a gargantuan ink kaiju crowned by a huge pen nib and horns of glowing ink-fire, with pen-nib claws and a gaping maw of broken glass shards in its chest
entry: A titan of living ink, tall as a castle tower. The shards of its shattered inkwell became its fangs, and old tales say whatever it writes with its claws comes true, so kingdoms once begged it never to write their names.
how: Evolve Incwell at level 50. It learns Crunch when it evolves.
